# Web: X 27-30, Y 0-20, Z 0-23

# Upper flange: X 27-57, Y 0-20, Z 20-23
upper = cq.Workplane("XY").box(30, 20, 3, centered=False).translate((27, 0, 20))

# Union into Z-bracket
bracket = lower.union(web).union(upper)
bracket_solid = bracket.val()

# Slots through flanges along Z: obround 15 long (end-to-end) x 5 wide, long side along X
# centred at (15,10) lower and (42,10) upper
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, 0), obj=bracket_solid)
    .pushPoints([(15, 10), (42, 10)])
    .slot2D(15, 5, 0)
    .cutThruAll()
)
